questions.q: The number of illiterate people fell from 150 lakh to 100 lakh. The percentage decrease is —
questions.work:
Decrease = 150 − 100 = 50 lakh.
Percentage decrease = 50/150 × 100 = 33⅓% (always divide by the original value).

What percent of the letters in the word 'PERCENTAGE' are E?
questions.work:
PERCENTAGE has 10 letters; E appears 3 times (pErcEntagE).
3/10 × 100 = 30%.

While calculating compound interest —
options: the principal remains the same every year

questions.work: In compound interest the interest of each year is added to the principal, so the principal for the next year is larger — it changes every year.

questions.q: The cost price of 10 articles equals the selling price of 8 articles. The gain or loss percent is —
questions.work:
Let C.P. of one article = ₹1; then C.P. of 10 = ₹10 = S.P. of 8, so S.P. of one = 10/8 = ₹1.25.
Gain = 0.25 on 1 ⇒ 25% gain.

questions.answer:
(i) False: 1.2 × 0.8 = 0.96, a net decrease of 4%.
(ii) True: 0.2/100 = 0.002.

questions.q: By reducing the selling price of an article by ₹50, a 5% gain turns into a 5% loss. Find the original selling price.
questions.answer:
The change from +5% to −5% is 10% of the C.P.
10% of C.P. = 50 ⇒ C.P. = ₹500.
Original S.P. = 500 × 105/100 = ₹525.

questions.q: A car bought for ₹5,50,000 on 1.1.2025 depreciates by 15% in the first year and 10% in every year after. Find its value on 31.12.2027.
The cost price of 25 articles equals the selling price of 20. Find the gain percent.
questions.answer:
Let C.P. of one article = ₹1. C.P. of 25 = ₹25 = S.P. of 20, so S.P. of one = 25/20 = ₹1.25.
Gain = 0.25 on 1 ⇒ 25%.

questions.q: A 10% fall in the price of tea lets a man buy 25 kg more for ₹20,000. Find the original and reduced prices per kg.
questions.answer:
10% of 20000 = ₹2,000 is saved, and it buys the extra 25 kg.
Reduced price = 2000/25 = ₹80 per kg.
Original price = 80 × 100/90 = ₹88.89 per kg.

In an election 75% of the voters cast their votes. The winner got 51% of the votes cast, which was 1530 votes. Find the total number of voters.
questions.answer:
Let there be V voters. Votes cast = 0.75V; winner's votes = 0.51 × 0.75V = 0.3825V.
0.3825V = 1530 ⇒ V = 4000.

questions.q: A shopkeeper sells rice at a profit of 10% and uses a weight which is 10% less than the actual weight. Find his total gain.
questions.answer:
For each 1 kg he charges for, he gives only 900 g.
Let the cost of 1 kg be ₹100: his cost is ₹90 (for 900 g) and he charges ₹110 (10% profit on 1 kg).
Gain = 110 − 90 = ₹20 on ₹90 ⇒ 20/90 × 100 = 22.22%.
